🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: cyclicals leadership (Energy, Industrials, Materials positive) and Financials ABOVE TREND (JPM (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND); leadership concentrated in Energy (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 top performers Energy).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: SLB (1W: +15.90% | 1M: +16.64%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +8.37% | 1M: +8.05%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +5.91% | 1M: +14.50%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +5.68% | 1M: +4.16%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -5.94%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.26% | 1M: +4.76%) CORRECTION. Consumer Staples and Healthcare weak: CL (1W: -3.51% | 1M: -1.62%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -0.50%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: SLB (1W: +15.90% | 1M: +16.64%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +1.99%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +9.57% | 1M: +0.09%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.76% | 1M: -10.03%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Energy).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -2.14%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -6.29% | 1M: +1.46%) CORRECTION, GILD (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -4.73%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -4.95% | 1M: +1.10%) CORRECTION, ABBV (1W: -4.26% | 1M: -4.37%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in large-cap Tech and select Healthcare names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: SLB (1W: +15.90% | 1M: +16.64%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +1.99%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.76% | 1M: -10.03%) RECOVERY — note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: several megacaps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA) show 1W vs 1M mismatch, so treat rallies as tactical not universal.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak with CORRECTIONs and RECOVERIES; AAPL (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -5.94%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.26% | 1M: +4.76%) CORRECTION — sector breadth: Technology negative (19 stocks).

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive and supportive of RISK-ON: JPM (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.34% | 1M: +7.34%) CORRECTION but positive on month, UNH not financial but Financials sector 1W: +1.00% | 1M: +7.04% (20 stocks) indicates durable breadth.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Cautious; JNJ (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -0.50%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -3.67% | 1M: -7.15%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.36% | 1M: +0.77%) CORRECTION — Healthcare showing weakness within a mixed market (sector 1W: -0.47%).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclical/value exposure given Energy and Industrials leadership (favor CVX (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.25% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +5.68% | 1M: +4.16%) ABOVE TREND) and Financials (JPM (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to rate-sensitive large-cap Tech (AAPL (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -5.94%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: SLB (1W: +15.90% | 1M: +16.64%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.76% | 1M: -10.03%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -6.29% | 1M: +1.46%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -2.14%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: strong within sector; large-cap names ABOVE TREND) and Industrials (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +5.83%). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -1.78%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -1.69%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch SLB to confirm follow-through above recent breakout (ABOVE TREND continuation), NVDA on any reversal back above short-term resistance (CORRECTION test), JPM to sustain 1M strength for broader financial leadership (ABOVE TREND).

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (+50): Intel launches new AI chips; INTC (1W: +8.76% | 1M: -10.03%) RECOVERY — news aligns with 1W strength but monthly weakness remains. CVX (+50): bullish headlines; CVX (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price. NVDA (+50): CEO says AI platform in production; NVDA (1W: -1.26% | 1M: +4.76%) CORRECTION — sentiment supportive but short-term pullback.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (-50): downgrade headlines; ADBE (1W: -6.29% | 1M: +1.46%) CORRECTION — price confirms negative flow. VLO (-40): bearish note on oil outlook; VLO (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +1.99%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverges from strong price, watch for distribution.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with Value/Cyclical style. SLB (1W: +15.90% | 1M: +16.64%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow leadership (Energy concentration) and major 1W/1M divergences in large-cap Tech (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA) — monitor sentiment-driven catalysts for confirmation.
